senses.gloss: ch. samehusk or kernel and flesh of one berry, v. preced.—Pl. זַגִּין.
units: Targ. Y. Num. VI, 4 ז׳ גוואין וכ׳ the interior zaggin, v. preced.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 28:34">Targ. O. Ex. XXVIII, 34</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>זַגִּין</he>, <he>זַגַּיָּא</he>, <cite ref="G00064"><he>זַגֵּי</he></cite>.
Nidd. 17ᵃ מקרקש זגי וכ׳ made the bells of his curtains ring; [Ar. מק׳ גַּזֵּי chased the flies, v. חִגְזִין].
